sources.title: Hunyuan3D: Free Image to 3D & Text to 3D AI Generator
sources.snippet: Turn any photo into a downloadable GLB with Hunyuan3D, the free open source AI 3D model generator. Image to 3D and text to 3D with baked PBR textures, in seconds.

sources.title: Hunyuan 3D - AI Image to 3D Model Generator | PBR & GLB Export
sources.snippet: Generate production-ready 3D models from images with Tencent Hunyuan 3D 3.1. Export GLB with 4K PBR textures for Unity, Unreal Engine & Blender. Fast AI 3D generation online.

sources.title: Hunyuan 3D | Free Open Source Text-to-3D & Image-to-3D AI
sources.snippet: Generate production-ready 3D assets with Hunyuan 3D. Free, open-source AI for text-to-3D and image-to-3D with PBR textures. Based on the open-source Hunyuan3D model (Apache 2.0). Runs locally on 6GB VRAM.
